about.paragraph1: Most agencies either only make videos or only buy ads. As a digital marketer and AI Video Creator, I connect the entire funnel. Through advanced prompt engineering, cinematic AI tools (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Luma), and Adobe Premiere / CapCut pacing, I craft visuals engineered to stop thumbs within the first 1.5 seconds.
about.strength3Desc: Fast AI production workflows delivering agency-quality 9:16 and 16:9 spots within 48–72 hours.
about.storyTitle: Turning Tight Budgets Into Scalable Conversations
about.paragraph2: Simultaneously, in Meta Ads Manager, I structure click-to-Messenger and lead-generation campaigns that transform modest daily spends—often as little as $2 to $5/day—into steady, trackable inquiries. I review cost per result every few days, shift budget to what’s converting, and constantly test fresh creative variations before ad fatigue sets in.

challenges: Ultra-tight daily ad budget ($2–$3/day) where every taka had to produce a direct order.
Needed a predictable, ongoing flow of local dining orders rather than a single spike.
strategy: Built targeted Click-to-Messenger campaigns with automated quick-reply menu triggers.
Tested fresh food creatives and localized micro-audiences weekly to prevent ad fatigue.
Sustained continuous campaign momentum over several months, keeping CPR steady at ~$0.04.
